text_block_list.text:
One time,
while walking near the outdoor stage—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, ngh-ngh, ngh-ngh!!
—Amabile!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, ngh-ngh, ngh-ngh!!
—A slightly green apple!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, ngh-ngh, ngh-ngh!!
—Scherzando!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, ngh-ngh, ngh-ngh!!
—The rings of a Baumkuchen!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, ngh-ngh, ngh-ngh!!
—Elegiaco!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, ngh-ngh, ngh-ngh!!
—Ramen noodle water!!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that was a fine lesson, Golshi-san.
Shion-san, how did it look from your perspective?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Umm...
I was totally overwhelmed by all that passion, but—

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Thinking about dancing together with everyone...
won't I stick out a bit?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
ââ!!!
Dominant Seventh...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I see, a concert is harmony...
At this rate, I won't be able to blend in with the musicistas...?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Ah, what on earth should I do—
It seems Sounds of Earth is troubled over dance lessons.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—!
Trainer, perfect timing!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"What do you think I should do?
For me to become a Triad...!?"
"To be honest, I don't understand it at all, but if there's one thing I can say—"
choice_data_list: Stay true to your unique individuality!
Stay true to your unique self!

text_block_list.text: "To be honest, I don't understand it at all, but if there's one thing I can say—"
choice_data_list: Stay true to your unique individuality!
Stay true to your unique self!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? Matomari? Katamari? Kamatari? 794 Heian-kyo...?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: ――Hey! Monkfish liver!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it's monkfish liver, monkfish liver!!
Earth, we're making hot pot right now!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The hint's gotta be in there...
For us to become the Triad!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
I see, monkfish liver...!
So that's where you'll get your hint, Golshi-san!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Understood! Then I shall go search for a pot at once!
Ciao, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
—...
Um, was this okay, I wonder...?

I don't understand anything... but regardless,
I prayed that they would be able to
find some sort of hint.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
—!
Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Telling me to dare to become the dominant seventh shining within the triad—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
You're telling me... to be the soloist
within the concerto, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, then all that remains is to hone
this melodía even further!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Golshi-san, I would love for you to accompany me!
Until I can become a soloist—!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! I'll turn you into the ultimate sledder
who can tear through any snowy mountain!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Did things... more or less settle down, I wonder?

For now, they are brimming with motivation.
I decided to believe that things would turn out just fine.
